name: search-scoped
title: Scoped search
description: One search box over several kinds of record or places, with a scope chip (Everywhere, Candidates, This project) that says where it looks; use it instead of a Search bar when one list of hits would bury the one wanted.

props.name: scopes
props.description: Where the search can look; the first is the default. Shown as a chip in the field. Without, it searches everything.

props.name: filters
props.description: What narrows the search inside the scope, typed as `key:value`.

props.name: groups
props.description: The results, one group per kind of record. Filtered here unless `filter` is off.

props.name: recent
props.description: Earlier queries as strings (`formatScopedQuery`), newest first; shown before anything is typed.

props.name: value
props.description: The scope, the chips and the words, controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The scope, the chips and the words to start with.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change: a scope picked, a chip added or removed, a word typed.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A result picked (Enter or a click): the row, and the query that found it. The list closes.

props.name: scopeKey
props.description: The word before a typed scope: `in` in `in:candidates`.

props.name: filter
props.description: Filter `groups` here by scope, chips and words. Off when your server does it: then they show as given.

props.name: loading
props.description: The results are on their way: a Spinner and "Searching…" under what is shown.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches; gets the query as a string. Defaults to the `noResultsFor` label (`scopedSearchNoResultsIn` in a narrow scope).

props.name: hints
props.description: Key hints and the result count under the list.

props.name: open
props.description: The list, controlled. It opens on focus, typing and ↓, and closes on Escape, a pick or a press outside.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target for the list. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: A press or focus outside the field and the list; `preventDefault()` keeps the list open.
